subject: Welcome to your posting
intro: The Ambassador is away. You are Deputy Head of Mission, now Chargé d'Affaires a.i. in Port Hesperia. Capital assures you this is an opportunity. Capital is not here.

sections.title: Where things arrive
sections.text: Capital writes by secure fax, at the embassy only; ordinary mail goes to your office PC; the BlockBerry carries your diary and round reports. Whatever is still unanswered when the block ends is recorded as ignored, and Capital keeps a note.

sections.title: Time and embassy funds
sections.text: You have 4 Diplo-Points (DP) per block, tiredness and drink can reduce them; hospitality comes out of embassy funds. End the block to resolve your plans.

sections.title: The mission
sections.text: The ministerial visit is four arrangements, each a chain of steps shown in the “Ministerial visit” panel and in Mission Watch on the PC. Some steps open only later, and Capital and the host will change some of them on the way.

sections.title: People
sections.text: Colleagues and contacts trade favours; the “Who is who” notebook records who said what; gossip is welcome in the building, and may be false.

sections.title: Démarches
sections.text: Capital’s démarches wait on the board on the PC, and the choice of messenger matters more than the message.

sections.title: Languages
sections.text: Ombrazian is learned by lessons and by attempts, and the Ministry will examine you on Day 13.

sections.title: Your personnel file
sections.text: It changes with what you do, and it is kept whether or not you read it.

sections.title: Morning press review
sections.text: Every morning Lucien Falk compiles the local press, or Maxim the intern does, with a horoscope in the translations. Reading costs 0 DP, you may forward one clipping to Capital a day, and the newspapers tend to know things before we do.

sections.title: Keep the posting
sections.text: Complete all four ministerial visit arrangements before arrival. Exhaust HQ goodwill and you are replaced; exhaust host-country goodwill and you are declared persona non grata. A cancelled visit is not considered an innovative scheduling solution.
